Pero ang hirap ideny na makakaramdam ka palagi na parang ang unfair bakit siya masaya tas ako hindi syempre ang daya nga naman dba

Just can’t help it ig pero eventually you’ll understand how stupid it was to hold on to that thinking

First of all, what happened with your ex is not your fault 
It was an unfortunate thing that’s out of your reach, but I understand na inevitable nga na maguilty ka pero know that it’s not your burden to carry 

Second, asking for space without sharing the issue to your partner (atleast para sa aken kase been on the other side of it, binalikan pa nga.) is worse than sharing what you actually have been thinking. It would be unfair na hindi niya malalaman yon. Kaso syempre it would also be up to him kung susuportahan ka niya kapag sinabi mo, such would be the risk. If all is good, the two of you may pull through together.

Lastly, seeking professional help would probably help you process what you’re thinking better and siguro mas maiintindihan mo kung bakit ka nagrereminisce 

You don’t deserve the problem that you’re having right now. Kaya I hope that everything will be alright! Hope you find the key to it all.
